court: In the High Court of Madras
appellants: CARE Ratings Limited Represented by its Authorised Signatory-P. Sandeep … Applicant(s);
respondents: 63 Moons Technologies Limited (formerly known as Financial Technologies (India) Ltd.) Rep by its Authorised Signatory D. John Dheepka and Others … Respondent(s).
sections_referred: Order XXXIX Rule 4 of Civil Procedure Code, 1908
advocates: For Applicant(s): Mr. R. Parthasarathy, Senior Counsel
judgment_text:
This application filed under Order XIV Rule 8 of Original Side Rules read with Order XXXIX Rule 4 and Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, seeking to discharge the interim injunction dated 1-2-2023 passed in O.A. Nos. 230-232/2020, A. Nos. 1431-1433, 2676, 2677, 2786-2788, 2877, 2883, 3069, 3294, 3295/2020 and 657-659/2020 in C.S. No. 154 of 2020 in so far as the Applicant is concerned in view of the Fixed Deposit receipts (dated 21-5-2026 bearing Nos. 0741106 and 0741112 drawn on Indian Bank (Chetput Branch) deposited in the name of the Registrar, High Court of Madras.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

K. Kumaresh Babu, J.:— By order dated 1-2-2023, injunctions were granted passed against the defendants, which was to be continued to operate till the defendants comply with the conditions enumerated therein.

2. The applicant, who is the sixth defendant, was directed to furnish a security to an extent of 10% of the Suit claim and it is the claim of the applicant that it had produced two Fixed Deposit receipts to the value of Rs 23 crores 16 lakhs and the same had also been placed before this Court. Original Fixed Deposit receipts issued by the Indian Bank, Corporate Office, Chennai in favour of the Registrar General of Madras High Court/CARE RATINGS LIMITED, are to mature on 22-5-2031.

3. In view of the compliance of the order in respect of the applicant, the injunction as granted against the applicant/VI defendant shall stand raised.

4. This order is without prejudice to the rights of the parties in the intra-Court appeal in O.S.A. Nos. 63 to 67 of 2023.

5. Registry is directed to transmit the Fixed Deposit Receipts to the Registrar General of Madras High Court.

6. Application No. 2186 of 2026 is ordered.

7. List Application No. 1409 of 2024 on 23-6-2026.
